messages:
kevin: Opening a small PR to patch the on-prem migration doc: add quick PKCS#11 discovery snippet, an SSH-tunnel example for KMS, and an airgap checksum variant. github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1701 :wave:
mira: linking. please include exact commands for SHA verification and an scp fallback for isolated sites. SEs copy these verbatim.
sam: paste the tiny pkcs11 probe here so I can sanity-check it quickly.
kevin: probe we added: `for p in /usr/lib/* /usr/local/lib/* /opt/*; do [ -f "$p" ] && pkcs11-tool --module "$p" -L 2>/dev/null || true; done`
mira: ok. for the SSH tunnel add this one-liner so customers can forward local 8443 -> remote kms:8443: `ssh -fN -L 127.0.0.1:8443:kms.internal:8443 bastion@bastion.example.com -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=60` and a systemd unit example.
sam: wording nit: replace "expose certs" with "KMS must present a certificate chain signed by the customer's root CA; private key material must remain on the HSM or restricted KMS host." Legal was clear.
kevin: changed wording everywhere. Added an openssl SNI check: `openssl s_client -connect 127.0.0.1:8443 -servername kms.internal -showcerts` and the SHA512 verify example for larger images: `curl -fSLO https://mirror.redwood.internal/images.tar.gz && curl -fSLO https://mirror.redwood.internal/images.tar.gz.sha512 && sha512sum -c images.tar.gz.sha512` plus scp fallback.
docs-bot: PR 1701: label set to docs-review. 2 reviewers requested: @mira, @sam.
mira: will review later today; focusing on exact commands and short vendor note about common PKCS#11 install paths.
kevin: thanks — planning to merge after green CI and then backport a one-line pointer into the migration checklist for SEs.
